name: SAMSØLINJEN's ferries Kalundborg–Ballen, trucks
law: SAMSØLINJEN's freight prices for 2027 per single trip (excluding VAT) on Kalundborg–Ballen: Lastbil maks. 10 m DKK 195; Lastbil maks. 12 m DKK 300; Sættevogn maks. 17 m DKK 300; Vogntog maks. 19 m DKK 300; Tillæg pr. ekstra påbegyndt meter over 20 meter: DKK 17. By length, without VAT: DKK up to 10 m 195, 10-20 m 300, 20-21 m 317, 21-22 m 334, 22-23 m 351, 23-24 m 368, 24-25 m 385, 25-26 m 402. The road train's price runs to 20 m, where the price per metre over begins, as the state's contract prices goods vehicles over 10 m up to 20 m alike. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where the line goes out on its car ferry line.
